nodes.description: Owned.owner: current owner address, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner for the two-step ownership handover (transferOwnership/acceptOwnership).
EduMetrix.symbol: public token symbol ('EMC').
EduMetrix.name: public token name ('EduMetrix').
EduMetrix.decimals: public token decimals (18).
EduMetrix._totalSupply: total token supply, minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
EduMetrix.balances: mapping(address => uint) token balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
EduMetrix.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) ERC20 allowances, mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller address used for ownership checks and for indexing balances/allowed.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) inside approveAndCall: arbitrary code execution after an allowance state write.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) inside transferAnyERC20Token: arbitrary token contract invoked with attacker-chosen address.
Unchecked arithmetic: '_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]' in totalSupply() is not routed through SafeMath.safeSub.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a); c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0); c = a / b.
ERC20Interface.totalSupply() declaration (constant, returns uint).
ERC20Interface.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) declaration.
ERC20Interface.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) declaration.
ERC20Interface.transfer(address to, uint tokens) declaration, implemented by EduMetrix.
ERC20Interface.approve(address spender, uint tokens) declaration, implemented by EduMetrix.
ERC20Interface.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) declaration, implemented by EduMetrix.
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval(address from, uint256 tokens, address token, bytes data) declaration invoked by approveAndCall.
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner), guarded by onlyOwner: stages newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): require(msg.sender == newOwner), emits OwnershipTransferred, moves owner and zeroes newOwner.
Owned.onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate.
EduMetrix constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and pre-mints the whole supply to 0xd6b72d0e2D99565f67a18e2235a8Ac595cbcE55A.
EduMetrix.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
EduMetrix.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
EduMetrix.transfer(address to, uint tokens): safeSub from msg.sender, safeAdd to recipient, emits Transfer.
EduMetrix.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
EduMetrix.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): safeSub balance and allowance, safeAdd recipient balance.
EduMetrix.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
EduMetrix.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval (external callback).
EduMetrix fallback function (payable): always revert(), rejecting plain ETH.
EduMetrix.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens), onlyOwner: external ERC20 transfer to owner.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner to gate privileged functions.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before ownership is transferred.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
onlyOwner guards transferAnyERC20Token.
transferOwnership stages the caller-supplied _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0), completing the two-step handover.
Constructor initializes symbol.
Constructor initializes name.
Constructor initializes decimals.
Constructor mints the fixed _totalSupply.
Constructor pre-assigns the whole supply to the fixed deployer address in balances.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply() performs an unchecked subtraction '_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]' outside SafeMath.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer writes sender and recipient entries of balances.
transfer indexes balances with msg.sender, so the caller controls whose balance is debited.
transfer delegates the debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit to safeAdd.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve sets the allowance owner from msg.sender.
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses safeSub for both balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key for the allowance check path.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as allowance owner and as the 'from' forwarded to receiveApproval.
approveAndCall invokes arbitrary spender code via receiveApproval after a state write, enabling reentrant calls into transferFrom/approve.
msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument of the receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract supplied by the caller.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered foreign tokens to the privileged owner address.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a only exists to feed SafeMath.safeAdd; it carries no independent state and collapses into the function node.
Parameter b only exists to feed SafeMath.safeAdd and can be merged into that function.
Local c is the temporary result of safeAdd and has no semantics outside that function.
Parameter a is a pure input of SafeMath.safeSub.
Parameter b is a pure input of SafeMath.safeSub.
Local c holds the subtrahend result and is only meaningful inside safeSub.
Parameter a is a pure input of SafeMath.safeMul.
Parameter b is a pure input of SafeMath.safeMul.
Local c holds the multiplication result and is only meaningful inside safeMul.
Parameter a is a pure input of SafeMath.safeDiv.
Parameter b is a pure input of SafeMath.safeDiv.

The _newOwner argument is only consumed by transferOwnership to update newOwner.
The tokenOwner argument is only used as a lookup key in balanceOf.
The to argument is only used as the credit key inside transfer.
The tokens argument is only the amount moved inside transfer.
The spender argument is only used as an allowance key inside approve.
The tokens argument is only the allowance value set inside approve.
The from argument is only the debited account key inside transferFrom.
The to argument is only the credited account key inside transferFrom.
The tokens argument is only the transferred amount inside transferFrom.
The tokenOwner argument is only a lookup key inside allowance.
The spender argument is only a lookup key inside allowance.
The spender argument is the address of the untrusted contract invoked via receiveApproval, so it normalizes into the external-call unsafe operation.
The tokens argument is both the allowance amount and an argument of the untrusted callback call.
The data argument is attacker-controlled payload forwarded straight into the external callback.
The tokenAddress argument is the target of the external ERC20 call and collapses into that unsafe operation.
The tokens argument is forwarded to the external token transfer call.
